prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: OpenFilm browser photo editor demo image and landing comparison. Primary request: Create a natural editorial photograph that immediately feels rewarding to color grade, crop, and adjust. Scene/backdrop: a woman in her late twenties standing inside a quiet greenhouse at the edge of late afternoon, surrounded by real leafy plants, weathered glass, and a simple wooden worktable. Subject: candid three-quarter environmental portrait, relaxed posture, no direct fashion pose. Style/medium: highly believable full-frame digital photograph with restrained 35mm film character, real skin texture, subtle grain, no synthetic gloss. Composition/framing: horizontal 3:2 frame, subject slightly right of center, layered foreground leaves, clear face, enough negative space and environmental detail for different crops. Lighting/mood: soft side light through glass with recoverable highlights, open shadows, warm skin, cool green foliage, broad tonal range without crushed blacks. Color palette: natural greens, warm cream, faded terracotta, neutral charcoal; balanced and not already heavily graded. Materials/textures: skin, linen shirt, foliage, condensation and aged wood should all retain fine detail. Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, no visible brand, no surreal objects, no exaggerated bokeh, no teal-orange blockbuster grade, no over-sharpening, no plastic skin. Avoid: obvious AI anatomy, duplicated leaves, impossible architecture, staged stock-photo smile, extreme saturation.
